fit_note: ShowUI is a single end-to-end 2B VLA (UI-guided visual token selection, interleaved vision-language-action streaming, curated grounding/navigation data recipe). Closest is K23: it trains a screenshot coordinate grounder on curated web/mobile/desktop element data with a unified JSON action space, but its headline novelty is efficient visual token selection, which no sub-pattern covers; K29 (action interface) is the runner-up.
